Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee

March 15-16, 2022

A joint meeting was held in the offices of the Board of Governors.

Attendance
Jerome H. Powell, Chair
John C. Williams, Vice Chair

Developments in Financial Markets and Open Market Operations
The manager turned first to a review of global financial market developments.

The ruble depreciated roughly 40 percent against the dollar.

Committee Policy Action
Members agreed to raise the target range to 1/4 to 1/2 percent.
